goal: Make Assurance follow-up notifications self-identifying so late or duplicated delivery can never be mistaken for current authority state: every user-visible notification carries its task_id and operation_id, and delivery for already-settled or terminal operations is suppressed or explicitly annotated superseded.

acceptance.assertion: Every Assurance notification and footer stage referring to a QA, Review, authorization, or completion event includes the task_id and operation_id it belongs to; a notification delivered after its operation has settled or after its task reached a terminal phase is suppressed or rendered with an explicit superseded marker and never prompts the user to act on stale state; injected out-of-order and duplicated events in a focused test produce only correctly correlated or annotated output.

The dispatch observability contract, protocol documentation, and packaged artifacts consistently describe the correlation fields and superseded-annotation behavior with no divergence between source and packaged text.
The complete Pi extension graph passes strict TypeScript checking and the full repository test suite passes with no regressions.
